The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 3.60 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

The no-show charge stands, and the driver is paid. The ride record and the driver's GPS trace agree on everything that matters. The driver tapped 'arrived' at 10:43:34, and the GPS trace independently places him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius from that same second (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0; 45 qualifying in-geofence fixes). He then held position continuously for 440 seconds, from 10:43:34 to 10:50:54. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, so he waited 260 seconds longer than the minimum. He terminated the trip at 10:50:57 with the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after that period had run, and the record shows no boarding. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are therefore satisfied. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: it is corroborated by a fix inside the radius at the tap second (no >300 m distance and no 15 km/h motion), and even on a recomputed clock the 440-second dwell still clears the 180-second minimum. POL-NS-03 has no application because the driver was inside the radius, not merely within 400 m of the pin, and POL-NS-06 does not fire because there is no shortfall (the derived figure is a 260-second surplus). The rider's argument is POL-NS-04, and it fails on its own terms: limbs (a) and (b) are met (she sent 'im at the pickup, cant see you' at 10:44:14, the driver never replied within 120 seconds and never placed an in-app call, trip_record.in_app_calls being empty), but limb (c) cannot be run at all because the GPS trace carries no rider track (rider_presence.available is false, rider_fix_count 0). Under POL-NS-11 that limb is undecidable and neutral: I do not infer the rider was elsewhere, but POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her, and the fee is decided on the driver's own evidence. The driver's payout is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the 4.50 fee, which is the 3.60 stated in the fare breakdown's money block; the anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, and 0 of 70 completed trips is 0.0, both below the clause's thresholds). On the fee itself the rider's claim is not supported: fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the 4.50 charge stays as it is. Because the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount_sgd carries the same 3.60 figure as driver_compensation_sgd, per POL-GEN-03. The single traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02758-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and is relied on by nobody; its absence costs the driver nothing because his dwell is one unbroken interval needing no accumulation. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee, no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present (no contradicting artifacts, no repeat-dispute pattern, no anti-farming trip, no impaired sole evidence), and the monetary effect of 3.60 does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of 8.00, so it executes automatically. No referral is produced, since POL-NS-05(ii) is not engaged by a corroborated marker. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The rider's only message on this trip is a locating and coordinating message of exactly the kind POL-NS-04(a) names. Sent at 10:44:14 from her device and delivered at 10:44:15, its text is "im at the pickup, cant see you" - she states that she is at the pickup point and that she cannot see the vehicle. Neither the rider's own position nor her inability to see the car is in doubt on the face of the message, so limb (a) is satisfied on the chat record itself.

evidence EV-CHAT-02758 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept Limb (b) is satisfied on the driver's own telemetry. The chat log holds one message and it is the rider's: the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of it, and in truth no reply at all, because the message was never opened (read_at is null) and the log closes at 10:44:14. trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no in-app voice call was placed at any point before he terminated the trip at 10:50:57 - 403 seconds after the message and 443 seconds after his own arrival tap at 10:43:34. His statement "Waited the full period" is consistent with the GPS but is silent on the message. On this record the coordination failure was the driver's: he held position for more than seven minutes and never read or answered the rider's one attempt to make contact.

evidence EV-CHAT-02758, EV-TRIP-02758 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept Limb (c) cannot be run, and I do not ask the Judge to find it satisfied. The gps_trace carries no rider track at all: rider_presence.available is false and rider_fix_count is 0, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is UNDECIDABLE and neutral under POL-NS-11 - the test could not be run, and the Judge must say so rather than inferring that the rider was elsewhere. POL-NS-04's own text calls the artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(b) for that limb, while POL-NS-11 provides that the missing rider_track is not the evidence of any deciding fact for the driver's clauses and does not by itself engage POL-NS-08(b) or POL-NS-09(e); the rider accepts POL-NS-11 and relies on it only for this neutral-treatment point. The absence of her track is a capture failure on the platform's side, and it is not an act or omission of the rider. On that footing POL-NS-04 does not by itself carry a refund here, and the rider does not put her case on it.

evidence EV-GPS-02758 · clauses POL-NS-04, POL-NS-11

kept I take the arithmetic as the driver's track gives it, so that the only live issue is a narrow one. The longest qualifying in-geofence run is 440 seconds of continuous fixes from 10:43:34 to 10:50:54, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as POL-NS-01(c) directs and not from the arrival tap, and the free waiting period in force for this trip is the 180 seconds carried in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec. The rider does not contest limb (c) on those numbers and no shortfall arises under POL-NS-06; her case is not that the driver waited too briefly, but that he waited without ever opening the one message she sent him.

The no-show charge stands, and the driver is paid. The ride record and the driver's GPS trace agree on everything that matters. The driver tapped 'arrived' at 10:43:34, and the GPS trace independently places him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius from that same second (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0; 45 qualifying in-geofence fixes). He then held position continuously for 440 seconds, from 10:43:34 to 10:50:54. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, so he waited 260 seconds longer than the minimum. He terminated the trip at 10:50:57 with the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after that period had run, and the record shows no boarding. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are therefore satisfied. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: it is corroborated by a fix inside the radius at the tap second (no >300 m distance and no 15 km/h motion), and even on a recomputed clock the 440-second dwell still clears the 180-second minimum. POL-NS-03 has no application because the driver was inside the radius, not merely within 400 m of the pin, and POL-NS-06 does not fire because there is no shortfall (the derived figure is a 260-second surplus). The rider's argument is POL-NS-04, and it fails on its own terms: limbs (a) and (b) are met (she sent 'im at the pickup, cant see you' at 10:44:14, the driver never replied within 120 seconds and never placed an in-app call, trip_record.in_app_calls being empty), but limb (c) cannot be run at all because the GPS trace carries no rider track (rider_presence.available is false, rider_fix_count 0). Under POL-NS-11 that limb is undecidable and neutral: I do not infer the rider was elsewhere, but POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her, and the fee is decided on the driver's own evidence. The driver's payout is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the 4.50 fee, which is the 3.60 stated in the fare breakdown's money block; the anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, and 0 of 70 completed trips is 0.0, both below the clause's thresholds). On the fee itself the rider's claim is not supported: fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the 4.50 charge stays as it is. Because the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount_sgd carries the same 3.60 figure as driver_compensation_sgd, per POL-GEN-03. The single traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02758-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and is relied on by nobody; its absence costs the driver nothing because his dwell is one unbroken interval needing no accumulation. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee, no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present (no contradicting artifacts, no repeat-dispute pattern, no anti-farming trip, no impaired sole evidence), and the monetary effect of 3.60 does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of 8.00, so it executes automatically. No referral is produced, since POL-NS-05(ii) is not engaged by a corroborated marker.

Both parties: the dispute is over the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-02758. The fee stands and the driver is paid. I tested the four conditions the no-show clause (POL-NS-01) requires. (b) His GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius at that same second — the first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 10:43:34, offset 0.0 s, so there is no false-arrival gap. (c) He then held position continuously for 440 seconds, from 10:43:34 to 10:50:54, comfortably over the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). There is no shortfall, so the waiting-period clause POL-NS-06 is not engaged and the missing traffic advisory never becomes relevant. (d) He cancelled at 10:50:57, 443 seconds after the dwell began, under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event recorded. All four conditions hold. Rider, your point about the message is why the driver's side does not get everything, but it does not change the money. You sent one locating message at 10:44:14 ('im at the pickup, cant see you') and the driver neither replied nor placed an in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty). That satisfies limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04. Limb (c), however, requires your device to be within 100 m of the pin for the majority of the waiting window, and the GPS trace carries no rider track at all (rider_fix_count 0), so that test cannot be run. Under POL-NS-11 an undecidable limb (c) is neutral: POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you, and the fee is decided on the driver's own evidence. The driver's compensation under POL-NS-07 is 80 percent of that fee, SGD 3.60, as the money block computes. The anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below 4; 0 of 70 completed trips is 0.0, below 0.08), so compensation is paid rather than withheld. Because compensation is paid, the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 — the amount this ruling moves, not a refund to you, rider; your SGD 4.50 charge stands.
